acceptance_criteria.criterion: Scope provenance admission lookup to the current Issue only so unrelated Issues/provenance do not change an Issue's authority timestamp.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: _max_provenance_admission accepts only the current Issue's exact planned (provenance_id, provenance_kind) pairs. test_finding_1_unrelated_issue_provenance_scoping proves a later unrelated Issue cannot move the first Issue's authority timestamp or content-addressed heads.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Validate the complete Source Handling policy decision/disposition vocabulary before any provenance or authority write.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: The shared validate_policy_body validator is used by production resolution, persistence preflight, and the provisioning option preflight. It enforces the governed category vocabulary, the exact four operation keys, type-safe disposition values, and UNKNOWN_CATEGORY's all-BLOCKED shape before provisioning writes.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Make interrupted provisioning recoverable without manually supplied --as-of.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: No---as-of recovery discovers only the current Issue's planned identities, resolves every discovered pair through the production provenance resolver before using known_at, and then checks exact content heads. Valid partial state converges to six provenance records and FACT/REGISTRY/POLICY; tampered, forged, wrong-kind, or mismatched state fails before an additional provenance or authority write.

defect_families.evidence: Provisioning rejects future and pre-authority --as-of values before storage initialization; no---as-of recovery derives time only from signature-verified current-Issue provenance.
Authority validation and publication remain on the existing transaction-bound Source Handling service path; the change adds preflight validation and verified recovery without a new persistence path.
Authority and provenance logical identities remain repository-derived, content-addressed, and bound to the exact Issue document identity.

The canonical policy validator rejects invented categories, missing or extra operation keys, malformed keys and values, and any non-BLOCKED UNKNOWN_CATEGORY disposition through SourceHandlingBlockedError.
UNKNOWN_CATEGORY remains non-persistable: it may be declared only with four explicit BLOCKED dispositions, and durable payload validation rejects fields that resolve to the sentinel.
Valid interrupted retries recover the verified provenance known_at and converge exactly; mismatched or tampered partial state fails without additional provenance or authority records.
All derived scopes and planned provenance identities remain bound to issue_agent_document_id for the exact authorization's repository and Issue number.
Content-addressed authority and provenance record IDs are preserved, and a matching-looking forged provenance record/head ID cannot bypass production signature and chain verification.
Strict-known recovery resolves through the production tamper-verifying provenance view before known_at is trusted, while authority known_at remains bounded by the current Issue's admitted provenance.
Policy publication preflight and runtime resolution use the same validate_policy_body implementation and exact canonical disposition operation vocabulary.

Malformed policy JSON shapes, non-string keys or values, unknown categories, and tampered recovered provenance fail through governed SourceHandlingBlockedError paths rather than permissive fallbacks or raw Python exceptions.
The candidate does not weaken connector receipt freshness, scope, or authenticated-write policy.
This canonical review is recorded against base 109a796e3a23ef294ff32885179dd76dd8016f6f, Issue 432, and the exact candidate content.
Idempotency is exact-match only; foreign content, wrong provenance kind, inconsistent timestamps or authority identities, and mismatched authority heads fail without superseding state.
Complete Fact and Policy vocabularies, including the exact durable operation-key set, are validated before the first Issue provenance or authority record is written.

Recovered retry state is selected by exact current-Issue provenance identities and kinds, authenticated by the production resolver, and checked for one consistent timestamp and authority identity before use.

findings.evidence: Provenance admission lookup was database-wide; it is now restricted to the current Issue's exact six planned identity/kind pairs.
Provisioning could write unsupported policy vocabulary; all Fact and Policy options now pass canonical preflight before any Issue provenance or authority write.
Interrupted no---as-of provisioning could not recover; valid exact partial state now recovers its timestamp and converges, while mismatched state fails closed.
Explicit invalid or future --as-of values previously initialized storage first; temporal validation now precedes repository initialization, with a regression that makes any early initialization fail.

Policies previously accepted invented durable categories. The canonical validator rejects all non-governed categories; the governed UNKNOWN_CATEGORY sentinel is separately constrained to an exact all-BLOCKED fail-closed shape.
Non-string policy and disposition values could raise raw TypeError. Explicit type checks now route malformed values through SourceHandlingBlockedError.
A runtime test fixture used an invented UNUSED_CATEGORY. It now uses the governed payload-unused DIAGNOSTIC category without weakening the production validator.

Recovered provenance was trusted from raw storage before integrity verification. Recovery now discovers only planned pairs and resolves each through the production tamper-verifying provenance resolver before using its timestamp, accepting idempotency, or performing any additional provenance or authority write.

UNKNOWN_CATEGORY was rejected entirely. The governed sentinel is now accepted only with the canonical exact four-operation all-BLOCKED disposition map; invented categories remain rejected and durable persistence remains impossible.

Durable disposition mappings accepted undeclared operation keys. The shared canonical validator now requires exactly PERSIST, READ_ACCESS, RECONSTRUCT, and DELETE_OR_EXPIRE and rejects missing, extra, or malformed keys fail closed.
